# Siemens secures major battery train order

Two German transport authorities have ordered 113 battery EMUs.

LOWER Saxony Transport Authority (LNVG) and Greater Braunschweig Regional Association (RGB) have awarded a €1.1bn contract to Siemens Mobility for 113 three-car Mireo Plus B BEMUs.

The contract includes maintenance for 30 years, the construction of two maintenance depots in Lower Saxony, and options for up to 132 additional trains.

The 160km/h BEMUs will start to enter service at the end of 2031 on lines that are only partially electrified. The batteries will be charged from the catenary while the trains are travelling on electrified sections.
